groups.description: Native cross-parent transfers and controlled conflicts

checks.requirement: Transfer steps to empty and populated checklists, before siblings and at the end in both directions.
Preserve native step and parent references and correct targeting across transfers and subsequent edits.
Reject invalid destinations visibly and leave stale source actions inert without recreating nodes.
Observe cross-parent transfers and edits from either client through native collaboration.
Prove concurrent native submissions and retain step label and completion edits across cross-parent transfers.
Prove concurrent deletion and editing, converge without resurrection, and preserve unrelated steps.
Late joiners and fresh browser sessions retain transferred identities and values after all originals close.
